spec.name: Mean reversion
spec.summary: Cointegrated pairs whose spread reverts in days to weeks.

mean_reversion.explanation: 1 pair out of 33 screened meets every need (corr >= 0.5; coint_p <= 0.05; half_life between 3 and 40). The best fit is JPM/BAC: cointegration p 0.037, half-life 5.3 days, correlation 0.75, spread z now +2.85. Statistics are in-sample, so treat them as a starting point.

arbitrage.explanation: 1 pair out of 29 screened meets every need (corr >= 0.6; coint_p <= 0.01; half_life <= 15). The best fit is SPY/IVV: cointegration p <0.001, half-life 1.0 days, correlation 1.00, spread z now -0.27. Statistics are in-sample, so treat them as a starting point.

spec.name: Hedging
spec.summary: Inverse pairs that are not cointegrated.

hedging.explanation: 11 pairs out of 11 screened meet every need (corr between -0.9 and -0.5; coint_p > 0.1). The best fit is QQQ/VIXY: cointegration p 0.736, half-life 31.1 days, correlation -0.70, spread z now -0.06. Statistics are in-sample, so treat them as a starting point.
